candidate.definition_en: Claim or assert that someone has done something illegal or wrong, typically without proof.
candidate.explanation_ar: يدعي أو يزعم إن حد عمل حاجة غلط بس من غير دليل قاطع.

senses.definition_en: Claim or assert that someone has done something illegal or wrong, typically without proof.
senses.explanation_ar: يدعي أو يزعم إن حد عمل حاجة غلط بس من غير دليل قاطع.
examples: The plaintiffs allege that the company misled investors about the risks.
Critics allege that the new policy will harm low-income families.
They allege that senior officials knew about the fraud for months.
